vectors.name: retained rows preserve foreign metadata and comments
vectors.source:
[_meta]
description = "Personal owned by user"
future_flag = true
sections_order = ["words"]
[_meta.sections.words]
description = "Words"
delay = 0.75
future = "section-owned"
# Keep this standalone comment.
[[words]]
"hello" = { output = "Bonjour", is_word = true, auto_expand = false, is_case_sensitive = false, final_result = false }
